title: 第19章 偷袭第20章 这恐怕不太妙
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
通过三次进化，李凡可以肯定一个结论。
大铁锅，一定是上古时期的异宝，并且和这些上古文字有某种联系。
熟悉的灵光闪耀，李凡满眼期待。
等到所有灵光再次被大铁锅吸收，这次进化应该是结束了。
实验正式开始。
第一天，李凡先实验大铁锅对于下品灵石的复制能力。
一千块下品灵石！
一天足足复制出一万块下品灵石。
天啊！
李凡看着眼前这一堆小山一般的灵石，有一点不真实的感觉，他用力掐自己一下，确定不是做梦。
这天，一向小富即安的李凡，搞出一次恶趣，他把一万块灵石，全部堆积在床上，抱着小山一般的灵石，呼呼大睡！
次日清晨，李凡醒来第一件事，是确定灵石还在，自己的经历是真实的！
下面，李凡开始实验中品灵石的复制。
和李凡的预计完全不一样，中品灵石，一天只能复制一块！
这是怎么回事？
一天可以复制一千块下品灵石，换算成中品灵石，应该是十块啊？
不甘心的李凡，一连实验十天，都是同样的结果。
沉思许久，李凡也没有找到合适的结论。
转换方向，试一试大铁锅修复法器的能力。
修复法器实验。

下品法器，这次只需要放进大铁锅一次，立刻恢复如初。
中品法器，则也是需要放进大铁锅一次。
至于上品法器，李凡手中暂时没有废弃破损的，还不能实验。
实验暂且结束。
李凡又拿出中品灵石，陷入沉思。
上古时期，修炼资源远远比现在丰富，中品灵石十分常见。
而到现在，中品灵石的数量锐减，已经根本没有新的灵石矿出产中品灵石。
等等！
李凡似乎抓到什么？
上古时期？
不错，这些中品灵石是几千年前的产物，或许是因为年代久远的缘故，大铁锅复制起来，有些困难！
应该是如此！
找到原因，李凡终于长出一口气。
休息片刻，李凡又从储物戒指中，拿出几瓶废丹。
五百多瓶废丹啊！
对于一向小富即安的李凡，不免一阵肉疼。
如果这些全部是真正的丹药，那李凡的身家估计可以远超一般的筑基期前辈。
心有不甘的李凡，将所有废丹全部拿出来，不厌其烦的全部检查一遍，当真是一粒真正的丹药都没有！
不仅如此，这些废丹大多是一个样，黑不溜秋的，根本分辨不出，到底都是些什么丹药。
废丹，废丹，还是废丹！

郁闷！
content_en:
After three evolutions, Li Fan can be certain of a conclusion.
The big iron pot must be a rare treasure from ancient times, and it must have some connection with these ancient characters.
A familiar aura shone, and Li Fan's eyes were filled with anticipation.
When all the spiritual light is absorbed by the big iron pot again, this evolution should be over.
The experiment officially begins.
On the first day, Li Fan first experimented with the large iron pot's ability to replicate low-grade spiritual stones.
A thousand low-grade spiritual stones!
A total of 10,000 low-grade spiritual stones were copied in one day.
Oh my God!
Li Fan looked at the pile of hill-like spiritual stones in front of him and felt a little unreal. He pinched himself hard to make sure it was not a dream.
On this day, Li Fan, who had always been content with being a rich man, made a bad move. He piled all 10,000 spiritual stones on the bed, hugged the small mountain of spiritual stones, and fell asleep!
The next morning, the first thing Li Fan did when he woke up was to make sure that the spirit stone was still there and that his experience was real!
Next, Li Fan began to experiment with the replication of mid-grade spiritual stones.
Completely different from Li Fan's expectation, only one mid-grade spiritual stone can be copied in a day!
What's going on?
A thousand low-grade spiritual stones can be copied in one day. If converted into medium-grade spiritual stones, it should be ten?
Unwilling to be reconciled, Li Fan experimented for ten days in a row, but got the same result.
After pondering for a long time, Li Fan could not find a suitable conclusion.
Change direction and try the ability of the big iron pot to repair magical objects.
Repair the magic weapon experiment.
The low-grade magic weapon only needs to be put into the large iron pot once this time, and it will be restored to its original state immediately.
A medium-grade magic weapon also needs to be put into a large iron pot once.
As for the high-grade magic weapons, Li Fan has no discarded or broken ones in his hands, so he can't experiment with them yet.
The experiment is over for now.
Li Fan took out the middle-grade spiritual stone again and fell into deep thought.
In ancient times, cultivation resources were far more abundant than now, and middle-grade spiritual stones were very common.
But now, the number of medium-grade spiritual stones has dropped sharply, and there are no new spiritual stone mines producing medium-grade spiritual stones at all.
etc!
What did Li Fan seem to have caught?
Ancient times?
Yes, these medium-grade spiritual stones were produced thousands of years ago. Perhaps because of their age, it would be difficult to copy the large iron pots!
It should be so!
After finding the reason, Li Fan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
After a short rest, Li Fan took out a few bottles of waste pills from the storage ring.
More than five hundred bottles of waste pills!
For Li Fan, who has always been content with being rich, he couldn't help but feel a pang of pain.
If these are all real elixirs, then Li Fan's net worth is estimated to be far higher than that of ordinary seniors in the foundation building stage.
Unwilling to do so, Li Fan took out all the useless elixirs and checked them all painstakingly. There was really not a single real elixir at all!
Not only that, most of these waste elixirs were the same, so dark that it was impossible to tell what elixirs they were.
Waste elixir, waste elixir, waste elixir!
depressed!
